items.title: Show HN: Engelbart – Mange Goals and TODOs for Claude Code
items.why_it_matters: Engelbart is a new open-source tool that automatically infers your project goals and TODOs from your Claude Code chat history and injects them back in as context. This is highly relevant because keeping Claude aligned on the next micro-step is the hardest part of vibe-coding as your project grows. Try cloning the Engelbart repo and running it alongside your AI-ingest project today to keep your shipping checklist front and center.

items.title: Claude Code "Feature Request: Support Agents.md": Closed as Completed
items.why_it_matters: Anthropic has officially resolved a major feature request to support custom instructions and context via an `Agents.md` file in Claude Code. This means you can now lock in your Next.js, Supabase, and Vercel stack preferences directly in your repository so Claude Code never suggests irrelevant packages or patterns. Try creating an `Agents.md` file in your AI-ingest repo today and explicitly write down your stack and coding rules.

items.title: Show HN: Doberman: The AI watchdog that stops Claude from deleting your database
items.why_it_matters: Doberman is an open-source runtime guardrail designed to intercept and block destructive LLM tool calls, like accidental database drops or file deletions. Since you rely on Claude Code to write and execute commands, having a safety net prevents a misunderstood prompt from wiping your Supabase tables. Try checking out the Doberman-Core GitHub repo this week to see how you can wrap its basic guardrails around your local development environment.

items.title: A tabbed desktop workspace for Claude Code
items.why_it_matters: InkShell is a new tabbed desktop workspace built specifically for running and managing Claude Code sessions. If you find yourself drowning in multiple terminal tabs for git, local servers, and Claude, this gives you a clean, dedicated GUI to keep your AI coding organized. Try downloading the InkShell client this week to run your next AI-ingest coding session.
